versions.content: Semantics of PortPrototype s PortPrototype s can have the following semantics: • A require-port (in technical terms: RPortPrototype ) requires certain services or data. • A provide-port (or PPortPrototype ) on the other hand provides services or data. • A provide-require-port (or PRPortPrototype ) combines the ability to provide and require services or data in one entity.
